channel.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI
channel.description: A non-AI view of GitHub Trending — a daily digest of open-source tools, libraries, languages, and projects trending right now.

item.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI — November 15, 2026
item.description:
Today's 50 trending open-source repositories, with AI-focused projects filtered out. Highlights:

  1. public-apis/public-apis (499,179 ⭐) — A collective list of free APIs
  2. freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp (459,160 ⭐) — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
  3. EbookFoundation/free-programming-books (401,622 ⭐) — :books: Freely available programming books
  4. nilbuild/developer-roadmap (372,048 ⭐) — Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
  5. vinta/awesome-python (334,886 ⭐) — The definitive list that answers "I want to do X in Python, which tool should I use?"
  6. practical-tutorials/project-based-learning (289,776 ⭐) — Curated list of project-based tutorials
  7. torvalds/linux (255,739 ⭐) — Linux kernel source tree
  8. react/react (252,634 ⭐) — The library for web and native user interfaces.
  9. TheAlgorithms/Python (226,126 ⭐) — All Algorithms implemented in Python
  10. ossu/computer-science (211,110 ⭐) — 🎓 Path to a free self-taught education in Computer Science!
